reasons: Ima hands the basket to Miri in scene 1 with the errand that sends her to Saba Elior.
Miri carries it through the village and delivers it to Saba in scene 4, where he takes the linen and the visit continues.
The basket recurs as a featured comic/resting spot for Nim in scenes 4 and 17.
story_role: the errand basket that brings Miri to Saba
